how: I get annoyed by the algo (want human music)
I ping you and ask for a playlist
I listen to it without skip
I pick a song I like
I write down a note about it
You may get a link to here **if you ask for it**
We may chat about music and that's cool

notes.title: Duvet
notes.body: You can just feel september in this song. It's still hot outside but you can sense that it's not gonna be like that for long. Did you know that it's actually the keyboard player playing the solo?

notes.title: Kiss from a Rose
notes.body: I absolutely love how organic this song sounds. You just know that it's played by humans in full.

notes.title: Fields of Gold
notes.body: I haven't given this song much thought until recently. It's one of those songs that it's so simple that it takes a genius to create it. Have you ever noticed that the bridge is a single note?

notes.title: Autumn Tactics
notes.body: I'm not sure where in autumn I would place this song. The vibe is a similar ending-type-beat like Duvet, but it also references October in the lyrics, but also winter's one breath away in November, so idk?
